evidence.title: Claude. - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Claude For Dummies
summary: Free beginner's guide to Claude: what it is, how it differs from ChatGPT, and how to use it.
description: A long-form free guide by Ruben Hassid (the How to AI newsletter) for people who have never used Claude. It covers what Claude is and how it works, Claude vs. ChatGPT, the plans and what they cost, prompting, what Claude is good and bad at, first-week exercises, and a closing section on how pros use Claude.
contains: 11 numbered sections plus a 'How pros use Claude' closing part
written for readers who have never opened an AI assistant
covers plans and costs, the three Claude products, prompting and first-week exercises
